A layout table renders its rows as list items, and those markers honour the bullets option like any other list

```r title="R"
library("htmltomarkdown", character.only = TRUE)

result <- convert(html = "<table><tr><td>alpha</td><td>beta</td></tr><tr><td><a href=\"/1\">a</a></td><td><a href=\"/2\">b</a></td><td><a href=\"/3\">c</a></td></tr></table>", options = ConversionOptions$from_json(jsonlite::toJSON(list("bullets" = "*+-"), auto_unbox = TRUE)))
print(result$content)
```
